prompt: How old was the first minister of the Ministry of Digital Affairs in Poland when Andrzej Halicki became minister?
answer: Anna Streżyńska, the first Minister of Digital Affairs, was born on **11 May 1966**. When Andrzej Halicki became Minister of Administration and Digitization on **22 September 2014**, she was **48 years old**.
